title: World Cup Day 2 - Eagle Resets the Radial Tire World Record, Leroy Enters TWO Grudge Races

event.name: World Cup (day 2, qualifying)
event.conditions: cold, early morning, 'great boost weather'; track 'really good'; later track getting cold; crosswind noted for Eagle Q2

people: Jamie (Eagle chassis/setup; caption also 'Jack stand' for Jamie in places - ambiguous)
Zach, James, Sam, Ty, Jackstand, George

sponsor_product_refs.fact: Mark Williams (drivetrain company bought by Motion Race Works a few weeks earlier) sells lug nuts with integrated bearing spacer

Front wheels coming slightly off the ground on the record run; tracked straight

passes.notes: won the side (win light) but slower of two 5.75s; ~5th in class qualifying

deep gash in tread found before Q2, replaced

spinning on shifts; Leroy won; crew side bets ($10/$100)
lifted - shaking tires badly on 1-2 shift

ecu.notes: team learning Haltech with help from Patrick

on the edge; whole class went faster
